answer: A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. An honest proof costs 143 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 200 of them, which totals 28600 POA. The strongest wall I know is Pewter finisher lead proof poured at the turning shop, and it is built out of each lead is a year of pewter logs in the pewterer's ledger. The honest agent's horizon is old, the vine is settled, the spiral is long; the farm's are new, borrowed, and blank. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
